I rent this small piece of land here near Dar, just a quarter hectare, and I grow some vegetables and other things to sell at the market. Cash is tight because I pay rent for the land, so I cannot put too much money into fertilizer — I will buy one small portion of urea if I can and also collect some chicken manure from a neighbor who keeps birds. I use local seed I saved because hybrid seed for what I grow is costly and the seller near me does not always have it. I spray a little pesticide when the insects come bad because in this hot coastal place the pests eat everything, and I fetch water from a nearby source to hand-water during the dry spells since the plot is small enough for me to manage with a bucket.
